### [Uber expands into 7 new European markets in food-delivery push, FT reports](https://www.reuters.com/technology/uber-enters-7-new-european-markets-food-delivery-push-ft-reports-2026-02-15/)

[Technologycategory](https://www.reuters.com/technology/) · February 15, 2026 · 12:21 AM EST · 2 hours ago

Uber plans to roll out its delivery business into seven new European countries this year, as tech groups ramp up their efforts in the multibillion-euro food-delivery market, the Financial Times reported on Sunday.
